<color_0002><Mint> can support <Cless>
in battle with her
<color_0003>clerical artes<color_0002>.
<pause>
She will use them automatically, but
if you need her to use a specific
one right away, select it manually
from the Artes menu.
<pause>
If there are any artes you don't
want her to use, you can <color_0002>restrict<color_0002>
her from using them.
<pause>
While in the Artes menu, move the
cursor to the arte and press <var_0302> to
<color_0003>restrict or allow<color_0002> their usage.
<pause>
<color_0003>Allowed<color_0002> artes will be displayed with
a <color_0000>light<color_0002> color, while <color_0003>restricted<color_0002> ones
will be displayed with a <color_0004>dark<color_0002> color.{END}
